matching_pages_notes: Original NARA PDF pages 95 through 100 and 102 through 109 were rendered at 180 dpi, and all 644 previously unaudited printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed spelling and initials, suffixes, rank or grade, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Page 101 had already passed visual review and was not re-imported. All reviewed rows agree with the current extraction. Literal source anomalies and visibly truncated cells remain unchanged, including Countouris Dennis N with the note possibly, G regory, Katehrine, Dorotothy, British A and Polish Ar notes, the duplicated Robert B Craig rows in different boxes, Crawford Archibald S with the note aka Arch, Crowley Harriet with docume, Cushing Benjaminn, Daulne with an asterisk first name and aka Jea note, Emiliy, Rymond, Deasonb, see file o, and Italian Ci. Private identifiers are not included in this review bundle or public assets.
